newsitem.title: USA: Intel's MMX had 27 pct share in Jan -study.
newsitem.headline: Intel's MMX had 27 pct share in Jan -study.

text.p: Desktop PC's using Intel Corp's MMX Pentium chip grabbed a 27 percent share of desktop units sold in January, according to an industry study.

MMX-based PCs sales marked their highest share of desktop PC unit sales in Consumer Electronics Superstores, at 38 percent, Computer Intelligence said its January StoreBoard Channel Tracking Service reported.
In the other retail channels tracked by StoreBoard -- namely, PC Superstores and Office Products Superstores -- MMX desktops were a lower portion of sales.
MMX is Intel's multimedia enhancement technology. January was the first month the technology was available to consumers.
Computer Intelligence is owned by Softbank Corp's Ziff-Davis International Media Group.
